entries.proposition: The review says WOREE MRI usually shows reduced myelination, citing among others Piard 2019 and Tarta-Arsene 2017.
entries.snippet: A magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of WOREE patients’ brains besides the varying brain structural defects usually shows also reduced myelination
entries.anchor: Section 'The WWOX gene modulates lipid metabolism', paragraph 4 (refs 13, 65-68)

entries.proposition: The osteopenia evidence in the body is the homozygous Wwox deletion in mice.
entries.snippet: the homozygous deletion of Wwox in mice caused disturbances in bone metabolism, such as osteopenia
entries.anchor: Section 'Influence of WWOX on bone metabolism', paragraph 1 (ref 24)

entries.proposition: The review's own verdict on WWOX and glucose metabolism in neurological disease.
entries.snippet: The role of WWOX in the control of glucose metabolism in the context of neurological diseases requires further research
entries.anchor: Section 'Participation of WWOX in glucose metabolism', end of paragraph 6

entries.proposition: The nuclear-translocation sentence, here only located; it was not re-verified against its primary in this event.
entries.snippet: Additionally, it increases the translocation of HIF1A to the nucleus
